title: Money: South African Coins and Notes
seo_title: Grade 1 Money Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise and identify the South African coins (5c, 10c, 20c, 50c, R1, R2, R5) and bank notes (R10, R20, R50); solve money problems involving totals and change in rands or cents.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 1 maths worksheets: South African coins and notes, counting money and shopping. 100 questions with pictures of rand coins and notes.
key_big: Count the value, not the coins.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • South African coins: 10c, 20c, 50c, R1, R2 and R5. Notes: R10, R20, R50, R100, R200.
  • 100 cents make R1.
  • Count the value, not the number of coins.
  • Start with the biggest coin when you count.

Examples

Example

R5 + R2 + R1

start with R5

Answer: R8

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting coinsAdd the values.
Bigger coinA big coin is not always worth more.
Cents or rands50c is less than R1.
